name: ProvenMetal

team.summary: The team consists of two technical founders, Will and Johnny, who previously operated out of a garage building circuit boards using prosumer-grade equipment before pivoting to front-of-house software automation.

evidence.quote: Hey HN, we’re Will & Johnny from ProvenMetal
We started off assembling circuit boards out of a garage with prosumer grade equipment

product.summary: ProvenMetal provides front-of-house automation and supply chain coordination for printed circuit board (PCB) fabrication and assembly, featuring KiCAD and Altium plugins that automatically procure components and manage manufacturing through partner networks.

evidence.quote: A customer gives us their design files, and we automatically procure components, and co-ordinate bare board fabs and assembly houses
KiCAD plugin: ( https://github.com/proven-metal/provenmetal-kicad )
Altium plugin: ( https://github.com/proven-metal/provenmetal-altium )

size_hint.summary: The US PCB market represents a domestic supply chain with significant demand from drone, defense, and hardware engineering teams requiring faster turnaround times than traditional overseas manufacturing.

evidence.quote: The US produced 30% of PCBs globally in 2000, now they produce 4%.
The fact that you call out Drone and Defense industries on your page suggests to me this is extremely expensive.

competitors.summary: Commenters noted several existing PCB manufacturers and brokers offering quick-turn or online quoting services.

evidence.quote: It’s interesting comparing what you’re offering and what they offer. When I started using them, the fact that you could just upload Eagle or KiCAD files, get an instant quote...
evidence.author: tonyarkles

evidence.quote: how does it compare to https://www.circuithub.com ?
evidence.author: otekengineering

evidence.quote: Each of these pretty established suppliers offer this service: Sunstone Advanced Assembly Sierra Circuits Osh Park
evidence.author: scott_h

why_now.summary: Increasing geopolitical focus on domestic supply chain security, combined with the availability of LLMs for automated DFM review and modern EDA tool plugins.

evidence.quote: Now, the need for a domestic PCB supply chain is higher than ever before, yet the infrastructure has been dissolving over the last 2 decades.
Automated DFM review uses Anthropic in zero-retention mode.

risks.risk: Heavy competition from entrenched domestic quick-turn PCB houses and significantly cheaper overseas manufacturers in China.

evidence.quote: Realistically, you can get boards in 7 days from China, and competing with them on price seems like a challenge.
Each of these pretty established suppliers offer this service: Sunstone, Advanced Assembly, Sierra Circuits, OSH Park

risks.risk: Component sourcing and supply chain latency represent uncontrollable external bottlenecks that can delay hardware builds.

evidence.quote: The bottleneck in assembling a PCB is usually component sourcing.
Assembly can't start until you have all units, and the hardest to source one is the bottleneck!

risks.risk: Lack of detailed documentation regarding manufacturing capabilities (layers, min trace/space) on the website frustrated potential technical users.

evidence.quote: First issue: I do not know what your manufacturing constraints are for PCBs...the number of layers is not documented.

founder_depth.why: Founders are technical and hands-on, having built PCBs out of a garage and developed EDA plugins, but lacked prior major domain exits or deep enterprise manufacturing backgrounds.

evidence.quote: Hey HN, we’re Will & Johnny from ProvenMetal
We started off assembling circuit boards out of a garage with prosumer grade equipment

shipping_evidence.why: The team has launched live KiCAD and Altium plugins, a functioning ordering website, and has successfully delivered initial paying customer orders.

evidence.quote: KiCAD plugin: ( https://github.com/proven-metal/provenmetal-kicad )
We took our first paying order in less than a week and we’ve done roughly $70k across 11 orders in 6 weeks.

demand_signal.why: Strong HN engagement with 237 points and 156 comments, accompanied by early revenue of $70k across 11 orders in 6 weeks and direct user interest from hardware engineers.

evidence.quote: Points: 237  Comments: 156
We took our first paying order in less than a week and we’ve done roughly $70k across 11 orders in 6 weeks.

defensibility.why: Defensibility relies primarily on workflow integrations (EDA plugins) and front-of-house automation profiles, though commenters noted numerous competitors and potential ease of copying software wrappers.

evidence.quote: When you work with customers during the design process, our plug-ins interact with KiCAD and Altium, sending the BOM to our ordering platform
Every manufacturer wants the same information in a different shape... We’re building a profile per manufacturer and sending the order to fit their requirements.

analysis.thesis_fit_reason: ProvenMetal builds developer tools and software integrations (EDA plugins) for hardware and electrical engineers to automate PCB procurement and manufacturing workflows.
analysis.case_summary: The strongest point for ProvenMetal is rapid initial traction ($70k in 6 weeks) and innovative EDA tool integration; the strongest point against is intense competition from established domestic and overseas PCB suppliers.
would_change_my_mind: Demonstrating consistent software-driven margin expansion without hitting physical capacity walls.
Publishing clear, comprehensive manufacturing capability sheets matching major competitors.
Proving long-term customer retention beyond early prototype or defense-dependent orders.
data_gaps: Detailed breakdown of unit economics and gross margins per order.
Exact composition of the partner fabrication network (geographic location and reliability metrics).
Comprehensive documentation of specific manufacturing tolerances, min trace/space, and stackup limitations.
